hypotheses.H1_universal_settling: Settling exists at all depths d>=2, with gain increasing with depth (same pattern as Falcon but smaller magnitude). Would confirm settling is architecture-universal.
hypotheses.H2_shallow_only: Settling exists only at d2, vanishes at d3-d4. Would suggest different mechanism than Falcon (attention shortcut vs recurrent integration).
hypotheses.H3_no_depth_scaling: Settling gain stays constant (~6%) across depths. Would suggest a single-mechanism explanation (e.g., attention pattern stabilization) rather than the depth-dependent cost law seen in Falcon.

falcon_svb1_comparison.note: Falcon gains grow with depth. Key question: does Qwen3 show the same depth-dependent growth?
